data.title: Bitcoin holds above $77,000 as Binance hack recovery takes shape
data.description: Investing.com -- Bitcoin traded slightly above $77,000 on Saturday as investors assessed fresh developments in the record $6.3 billion Binance hack, with Wall Street analysts suggesting the cryptocurrency’s recent selloff may have created buying opportunities.
